newsitem.title: CHINA: Fly national flag higher, China tells Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Fly national flag higher, China tells Hong Kong.

text.p: Beijing on Friday announced new regulations ordering Hong Kong flag wavers to make sure the national standard flies highest after the British colony returns to China at midnight on June 30.

Rules passed by the State Council, or cabinet, demanded the five-star scarlet flag of China have prominence whenever flown with the banner of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, which will be formed on July 1, the Xinhua news agency said.
Post-colonial Hong Kong will use a flag emblazoned with the territory's new official flower, the bauhinia, after the handover ends 156 years of colonial rule from London.
When the national flag and regional flag were used at the same time, the national flag must have the central, higher or more prominent position, Xinhua quoted the new rules as saying.

"When the two flags are used at the same time and placed side by side, the national flag should be larger than the regional flag, with the national flag taking the right position and the regional flag taking the left," it said.
In processions, the national flag should be raised in front of the regional flag, it said but gave no other details of post-colonial flag etiquette.
